summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 2,318,790 Class I common shares to feeder vehicles for gross proceeds of roughly $25.0 million, priced at the August 31, 2026 NAV of $10.7695 per Class I share, with the final share count set September 16, 2026. The placement relied on Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S exemptions. The same filing disclosed monthly NAV per share for Class S ($10.6910), Class N ($10.7825), Class D ($10.5440) and Class I. This is a routine intermittent NAV-based capital raise, not a special situation.
